# VouchTrack

> AI visibility and review management for US local businesses, run for you or self-serve (hair salons, nail salons, auto repair, dental, restaurants, HVAC & home services, and 15 more). VouchTrack shows a business owner where they currently stand in Google Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, names the competitors being recommended instead of them, and then does the work to close the gap. Published pricing ($29–$499/month), no contracts, 30-day money-back guarantee.

## What VouchTrack actually does

Three things decide whether an AI assistant names a local business:

1. **The Google Business Profile**: the structured record assistants read first: categories, services, hours, photos, answered questions.
2. **Review signals**: volume, recency, and the specific language customers use. This is the largest body of text about a business that an assistant can read and quote, and the only one that moves week to week.
3. **Content footprint**: the pages on the web that answer what people in the area are actually asking.

Every VouchTrack plan works lever 2. The Pro plan adds measurement across all three plus a ranked list of what to fix. The Done For You plans (Launch and Growth) do the fixing on levers 1 and 3.

VouchTrack does not guarantee that any AI assistant will recommend a given business, and says so publicly. AI answers vary by phrasing and change over time.

## Plans

- **Reviews / Starter: $49/mo** — self-serve. 2,000 emails + 400 texts, 2 review platforms, website widgets, feedback forms, QR codes, AI-drafted replies.
- **Reviews / Managed: $99/mo** — done for you. 5,000 emails + 1,000 texts, all 85+ review sources in one inbox, every review answered (AI-drafted, human-approved), private feedback flow, video testimonials, API access, white-glove setup.
- **AI Visibility / Visibility: $249/mo** — everything in Managed plus AI Hub tracking across Google Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, a monthly report naming who gets recommended instead, sentiment analysis, and a ranked fix list.
- **AI Visibility / Growth: $499/mo** — everything in Visibility plus complete Google Business Profile optimisation and 8 AEO-optimised articles published monthly. Optional one-time AI-optimised website build, $500. Limited availability.
- **AI Visibility / Enterprise: custom.**

Annual billing is 20% off on every plan. Additional locations are $99/month each on any plan except Starter. Extra messages: $2.50 per 100 texts, $2.50 per 1,000 emails.

Founding offer: the first 15 businesses lock in Visibility at $199/month for life.

## Facts

- Single location only. Franchises and chains are explicitly out of scope.
- United States only.
- Month to month. Cancel by email. Annual is a discount, not a contract.
- 30-day money-back guarantee on monthly and annual plans alike. The optional one-time website build is billed separately and sits outside it.
- Contact: hello@vouchtrack.com
